https://t.co/FV2w2dMczl' author: id: '2781760593' name: Flavio Adamo screenName: flavioAd profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1888748760680873984/3IkCAhjw_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 32 retweets: 3 replies: 1 quotes: 1 views: 18217 bookmarks: 9 createdAt: Wed Nov 12 19:39:21 +0000 2025 createdAtLocal: 2025-11-12 19:39 createdAtISO: '2025-11-12T19:39:21+00:00' media: [] urls: https://x.com/flavioAd/status/1988692639676526812?s=20 isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null quotedTweet: id: '1988692639676526812' text: "Been on GPT-5.1 early access the last few days, here’s my experience so\ \ far \U0001F447

Instant is basically the one I’d use by default now: more\ \ chill to chat with and better at just answering the question. 

Thinking\ \ feels like a focus mode and I love that it stays quick on the easy stuff
\ 
I wanted to test it with Codex, so I built a tiny X clone where every user\ \ is an LLM: they post, reply and argue with each other, and I wrote 0 lines\ \ of code, just prompts and function specs

I’ll break it down a bit more\ \ in the thread \U0001F53D" author: screenName: flavioAd name: Flavio Adamo id: '1988694204164502021' text: '@sama "what happened to GPT-6-7 and internal AGI" https://t.co/23qTJwHaUm' author: id: '1913314895635841024' name: dhruv screenName: hail_dhruv profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2071984713502281728/0twgLdEM_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 30 retweets: 0 replies: 1 quotes: 0 views: 8516 bookmarks: 0 createdAt: Wed Nov 12 19:43:41 +0000 2025 createdAtLocal: 2025-11-12 19:43 createdAtISO: '2025-11-12T19:43:41+00:00' media: type: photo url: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/G5lCuawbwAAKxxI.jpg width: 1686 height: 1142 urls: [] isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null id: '1988693845249507408' text: '@sama Nice stats https://t.co/V1Hf51U2Ox' author: id: '1579783530107883521' name: Florian S screenName: airesearch12 profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1942340330314956800/iTdMDC7t_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 28 retweets: 1 replies: 4 quotes: 0 views: 15085 bookmarks: 5 createdAt: Wed Nov 12 19:42:15 +0000 2025 createdAtLocal: 2025-11-12 19:42 createdAtISO: '2025-11-12T19:42:15+00:00' media: type: photo url: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/G5lCg12XAAA6S5L.jpg width: 1078 height: 1506 urls: [] isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null id: '1988757957438218495' text: '@sama https://t.co/9iws04DuGm
